# Ipsos

> > Global leader in market research, consumer insights, and public opinion analysis, providing data-driven intelligence through advanced research platforms and methodologies.

Ipsos is a worldwide market research and public opinion specialist offering comprehensive insights into consumer behavior, economic trends, and global attitudes. The company operates through regional hubs and proprietary platforms like Insight Cloud, Global Advisor, and Economic Pulse to deliver actionable intelligence to clients across industries.

## Key Topics

- Market Research
- Consumer Insights
- Global Advisor
- Insights Hub
- Brand Measurement
- Data Analytics
- Economic Pulse
- Insight Cloud
- CAPI/CATI Research Methods
- What Worries the World
- Consumer Confidence Index
- Trend Discovery
- Research Reports
- Public Opinion
- Vaccination Surveys

## Insights & Research Platforms

- [Insights Hub](https://www.ipsos.com/en/insights-hub): Central platform for expert insights, thought leadership, and market research data across global markets
- [Insights Hub (Middle East)](https://www.ipsos.com/en-ae/insights-hub): Regional hub for Ipsos market research insights and publications in the Middle East
- [Insights Hub (Ireland)](https://www.ipsos.com/en-ie/insights-hub): Regional hub for Ipsos market research insights and publications in Ireland

## News & Content

- [News & Events](https://www.ipsos.com/bs-ba/news-and-events/news): Archive of Ipsos news covering market research, COVID-19, global trends, and company updates
